facts.statement: The only known specimen is a single fossilized dorsal vertebra collected in 1889 by Hugo Zapałowicz.
facts.quote: The only known specimen of Nopcsaspondylus is a fossilized dorsal vertebra collected in 1889 by Slovenian researcher Hugo Zapałowicz

facts.statement: Hungarian paleontologist Franz Nopcsa von Felső-Szilvás first described the specimen in a 1902 publication.
facts.quote: Hungarian paleontologist Franz Nopcsa von Felső-Szilvás, described it in a 1902 publication

facts.statement: Argentine paleontologist Sebastián Apesteguía named the species Nopcsaspondylus alarconensis in 2007.
facts.quote: In 2007, Argentine paleontologist Sebastián Apesteguía became the first author to recognize that the vertebra described by Nopcsa represents a new genus and species

facts.statement: The dinosaur lived during the Early Cretaceous (Albian) in the Candeleros Formation of Neuquén, Argentina.
facts.quote: from the Early Cretaceous (Albian) Candeleros Formation of Neuquén, Argentina

facts.statement: It lived approximately 89 million years ago during the Coniacian stage of the Early Cretaceous in what is now South America.
facts.quote: que vivió a principios del período Cretácico, hace aproximadamente 89 millones de años, en el Coniaciense, en lo que es hoy Sudamérica

facts.statement: The fossil record dates from 113.2 to 110.1 million years ago.
facts.quote: Time range: Albian to Albian (113.2 to 110.1 million years ago)

facts.statement: The single known fossil is a vertebra with a small body and large hollows typical of rebbachisaurids.
facts.quote: The specimen had a small vertebral body and large hollows, now known to be typical of rebbachisaurids.

facts.statement: Estimates suggest the animal reached 15 meters in length, 4.5 meters in height, and weighed 10 tons.
facts.quote: Se cree que llegó a medir 15 metros de largo, una altura de 4,5 metros y un peso de 10 toneladas.

facts.statement: It is classified within the family Rebbachisauridae.
Its parent group is classified as Khebbashia.
Researcher Lerzo (2026) reevaluated the species and considered it a nomen dubium.
facts.quote: Lerzo (2026) reevaluates Nopcsaspondylus alarconensis and considers it to be a nomen dubium.

rejected.statement: Nopcsaspondylus is a dubious genus of rebbachisaurid sauropod dinosaur named after its original describer.
rejected.quote: Nopcsaspondylus (meaning "Nopcsa's vertebra", in reference to the original describer) is a dubious genus of rebbachisaurid sauropod dinosaur

rejected.statement: The genus name combines the surname of the first researcher with the Greek word for vertebra.
rejected.quote: The generic name combines the surname of the first researcher to study it with the Greek word σπονδυλος (, meaning "vertebra")

rejected.statement: A 2026 reassessment concluded that Nopcsaspondylus is a nomen dubium because it lacks diagnostic features to distinguish it from other rebbachisaurids.
rejected.quote: A 2026 reassessment of Nopcsaspondylus concluded it is a nomen dubium since it lacks diagnostic features to distinguish it from other rebbachisaurids.
